CREATE TABLE [BUSC].[BOB_TBLUSR_DELTA]
( 
	SRC_HR VARCHAR(50),
	TGT_HR VARCHAR(50),
	ID nvarchar(30),
	isActive int,
	isLatest int,
	RECORD_STATUS VARCHAR(10)

)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO




------------------------------------
WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACCESS_FLAG,ALLOW_PSWD_EXP,BDAY,BRANCH_ID,CD,CHANGE_CNT,CHNG_PSWD_FLAG,COUNTRY_NO,CREATED_BY,CREATED_DT,CUMM_CNT,DEL,DEPT_ID,EFFECTIVITY_DT,EMAIL,EXP_DT,FIRST_NM,GRP_ID,ID,IMAGE,INV_LOGIN_CNT,IS_ALL_CORPORATION,IS_LOGIN,LAST_LOGIN_DT,LAST_NM,LAST_PSWD_UPD_DT,LOCAL_TRUNK_NO,MID_NM,MOBILE_NO,OLD_STATUS,OVRD_LIMIT,PSWD,PSWD_ALT,RETRY_CNT,SESSION_ID,STATUS,SUSPEND_DT_FROM,SUSPEND_DT_TO,UPDATED_BY,UPDATED_DT,VERSION))
	AS HASHROW,
	ID, DEL, VERSION, CD
FROM (	SELECT [ID] ,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACCESS_FLAG],' ',''),''),0)) as ACCESS_FLAG ,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ALLOW_PSWD_EXP],' ',''),''),0)) as ALLOW_PSWD_EXP ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[BDAY]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000') as BDAY ,[BRANCH_ID] ,[CD] ,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CHANGE_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as CHANGE_CNT ,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CHNG_PSWD_FLAG],' ',''),''),0)) as CHNG_PSWD_FLAG ,[COUNTRY_NO] ,[CREATED_BY] ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[CREATED_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000') as CREATED_DT ,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CUMM_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as CUMM_CNT ,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([DEL],' ',''),''),0)) as DEL ,[DEPT_ID] ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[EFFECTIVITY_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000') as EFFECTIVITY_DT ,[EMAIL] ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[EXP_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000') as EXP_DT ,[FIRST_NM] ,[GRP_ID] ,[IMAGE] ,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([INV_LOGIN_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as INV_LOGIN_CNT ,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([IS_ALL_CORPORATION],' ',''),''),0)) as IS_ALL_CORPORATION ,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([IS_LOGIN],' ',''),''),0)) as IS_LOGIN ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[LAST_LOGIN_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000') as LAST_LOGIN_DT ,[LAST_NM] ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[LAST_PSWD_UPD_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000') as LAST_PSWD_UPD_DT ,[LOCAL_TRUNK_NO] ,[MID_NM] ,[MOBILE_NO] ,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([OLD_STATUS],' ',''),''),0)) as OLD_STATUS ,convert(numeric(15,2),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([OVRD_LIMIT],' ',''),''),0)) as OVRD_LIMIT ,[PSWD] ,[PSWD_ALT] ,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([RETRY_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as RETRY_CNT ,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([STATUS],' ',''),''),0)) as STATUS ,[SESSION_ID] ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[SUSPEND_DT_FROM]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000') as SUSPEND_DT_FROM ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[SUSPEND_DT_TO]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000') as SUSPEND_DT_TO ,[UPDATED_BY] ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[UPDATED_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000') as UPDATED_DT ,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VERSION],' ',''),''),0)) as VERSION  ,1 as isActive ,1 as isLatest ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]  ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]  ,[FILE_NAME]  ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000') as insert_dttm  FROM [d360].[STG_BOB_TBLUSR]     WHERE H = 'D'
) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACCESS_FLAG,ALLOW_PSWD_EXP,BDAY,BRANCH_ID,CD,CHANGE_CNT,CHNG_PSWD_FLAG,COUNTRY_NO,CREATED_BY,CREATED_DT,CUMM_CNT,DEL,DEPT_ID,EFFECTIVITY_DT,EMAIL,EXP_DT,FIRST_NM,GRP_ID,ID,IMAGE,INV_LOGIN_CNT,IS_ALL_CORPORATION,IS_LOGIN,LAST_LOGIN_DT,LAST_NM,LAST_PSWD_UPD_DT,LOCAL_TRUNK_NO,MID_NM,MOBILE_NO,OLD_STATUS,OVRD_LIMIT,PSWD,PSWD_ALT,RETRY_CNT,SESSION_ID,STATUS,SUSPEND_DT_FROM,SUSPEND_DT_TO,UPDATED_BY,UPDATED_DT,VERSION))
	AS HASHROW,
	ID, DEL, VERSION, CD
	
FROM	BUSC.BOB_TBLUSR
WHERE	isLatest = 1
)	
INSERT INTO BUSC.BOB_TBLUSR_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ID,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ID,TGT.ID) AS ID	
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ID IS NULL AND SRC.VERSION IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ID IS NULL AND SRC.VERSION IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
	    WHEN (SRC.ID IS NULL AND TGT.VERSION IS NULL) OR (Convert(varchar,SRC.DEL) = 'Y' OR Convert(varchar,SRC.DEL)  = '1')  THEN 'DELETE'
	    WHEN TGT.ID IS NULL AND TGT.VERSION IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
	    WHEN SRC.HASHROW != TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.ID = TGT.ID
AND	SRC.VERSION = TGT.VERSION
AND SRC.CD = TGT.CD
	
WHERE	(
	SRC.ID IS NULL OR TGT.ID IS NULL
    OR SRC.VERSION IS NULL OR TGT.VERSION IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
